text: A traditional wedding ceremony in a church, minister mid-vows, bride and groom at the altar, guests seated in the pews
The back doors of the church burst open, a figure appears in the doorway, guests turning in shock
The figure strides quickly down the aisle as guests gasp and murmur
The groom steps slightly in front of the bride, the figure now near the altar steps
The figure declares the objection at the altar, wide shot of stunned guests
